subject: dbc_contracts
summary: Reservation.ocl#reserve keeps W1 happy-path pre/post and elevates W2 insufficient-stock failure to checkable properties: SufficientAvailableStock remains a hard pre; posts InsufficientStockError (oclIsInvalid), NoHoldCreatedOnInsufficientStock, and AvailableStockUnchangedOnInsufficientStock state named failure with no hold and unchanged stock. Comment maps the violation to InsufficientStockError shared with OpenAPI. Not vacuous at standard density; no W1 regression.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text
lint: overlapping touches across W2–W5 on shared OCL/OpenAPI/src; solidsdd-run must serialize these items

InsufficientStockError is named in comments and a post label with result.oclIsInvalid(); no formal OCL raises clause. Acceptable at standard density (error class is adapter/runtime SoT with OpenAPI), but a raises/typed exceptional result would sharpen the contract further.
